events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his unique brand of humour has entertained generations. Which of his roles is your all-time favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, making this its 58th anniversary.

angles.name: Iconic double album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. A bold statement with its minimalist cover and incredibly diverse tracks. What's your standout song from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Remembering Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 in 2026.

angles.name: Legendary showman
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's the Queen song that always gives you goosebumps?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking its 61st anniversary.

angles.name: Revolutionary sound
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that pushed boundaries and showcased their evolving artistry. A true game-changer! What's your favourite track from this era-defining record?

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980, at the age of 40. He would have been 86 in 2026.

angles.name: Peace and music
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. The influential musician passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Starman's legacy
angles.copy: Today, we remember the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable. What's your favourite Bowie era or alter ego?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering 'The King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today. He passed away in 1977.

angles.name: The King's enduring charm
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. His music still moves generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's colossal sound, his riffs are timeless. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track that showcases his genius?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rock and pop legend
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to his solo hits, his distinctive voice has given us so many classics. Which Rod song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the charismatic frontman of Madness, Suggs! So many brilliant tunes and unforgettable performances. What's your favourite Madness singalong?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: 80s pop icon
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! His hits defined the 80s for many of us. Which of his songs still gets you singing along?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today. She passed away in 2026.

angles.name: Country Queen's legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the incredible legacy of Dolly Parton. A true icon whose music transcended genres. What's your favourite Dolly track?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Take That leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A fantastic songwriter and performer who's given us so many memorable songs. What's your top Gary Barlow or Take That hit?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legend that is Billy Ocean! His soulful voice gave us some of the greatest hits of the 80s. Which Billy Ocean track is your personal anthem?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, cementing the legacies of rock's founding fathers. Who would be your first pick for induction if you ran the show?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to their enduring success, he's been a key part of the pop landscape. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic final performance
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The final public performance from the Fab Four – a truly unforgettable moment in music. Which song from that legendary set is your favourite?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed British singer-songwriter and Genesis drummer Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Music legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A phenomenal drummer and a voice that defined decades of hits. What's your favourite Phil Collins track, solo or with Genesis?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boy band heartthrob to solo superstar, he's consistently delivered the hits. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has brought us so much joy. Which of his iconic characters is your absolute favourite?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Rock and Roll tragedy
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost three pioneers of rock and roll: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. 'The Day The Music Died' is a poignant reminder of their enduring legacy. What's your favourite track from these legends?
